summary: Interim deviation note WA/2025/407 for Quorenthel Pharma GmbH, QP07 clinical prototype. Records that new ICH chamber pulls are suspended while the prototype composition changes, summarises interim stability and method validation data, and lists the retained samples and restart points still awaiting client instruction.

title_block.title: QP07 Clinical Prototype: Stability Hold Note
title_block.subtitle: Deviation note, interim
lines: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company

blocks.p: This note records the hold placed on new pulls from the QP07 stability programme after Quorenthel Pharma GmbH notified us of a change to the prototype composition. It sets out the interim data already generated, the samples still in chamber and the points that need client instruction before testing can restart. Conclusions are interim and stay within the tested conditions.

The QP07 clinical prototype entered the ICH chamber programme at 25 °C/60% RH, 30 °C/65% RH and 40 °C/75% RH. Table 2 records the available HPLC method qualification checks; full validation and transfer conclusions remain pending.

On the notification received from the client, the prototype composition is being changed and instructions for further testing of the current lot remain unresolved. New pulls were suspended from the date of the hold. Samples already in the chambers are retained under the storage conditions of the protocol.

Table 1 gives the initial (time-zero) results placed at all three conditions; every result complies with the specification, with assay at {{PRJ0103:stability.t0_assay}}% label claim. New pulls were suspended before the first scheduled timepoint, so no trend with time can be assessed yet.

table.caption: Table 1 Interim stability results (assay % label claim; impurities % area; water KF % w/w)

blocks.p: Imp B RRT 1.12 is reported below the limit shown in Table 1. The table contains time-zero results only; there are no post-storage results to interpret. Existing chamber samples are retained pending instructions; the pull schedule is [TBC].

The linearity, range and accuracy checks shown in Table 2 meet their listed acceptance criteria. These checks do not establish complete assay and related-substances validation or method transfer. [TBC: confirm outstanding validation and transfer work, including robustness, before final issue.]

Retained samples for the QP07 lot are held in the chambers under the protocol storage conditions. The number of units in each chamber is XX pending a physical count at the next scheduled chamber check, and the count will be recorded against the batch card when it is done.

list: No further stability pulls to be taken until the client confirms the restart instruction in writing
Retained samples not to be discarded or moved without a written instruction
Restart date and any change to the pull schedule: [TBC]

blocks.p: Project status is on hold. Completion date and final outcome are not set and will be recorded at close-out.

The project lead will write to the client to request the restart instruction and the revised composition details. Stability and method validation records stay open until the client gives the instruction. Any further pulls will be reported as a separate interim update so that results from the old and new composition are not mixed in one table.
